# Array UI (aui) - shadcn Registry

> The arpitbhayani.me look as a shadcn registry: paper light & obsidian carbon themes, Plus Jakarta Sans & Lora typography, signature crimson accent (#e5000f), amber maxim callouts, machined telemetry terminals, and systems engineering developer primitives. Components are copied into your app with the shadcn CLI.

## Quick Installation

Add the registry to your `components.json`:
```json
{
  "$schema": "https://ui.shadcn.com/schema.json",
  "style": "default",
  "registries": {
    "@aui": "https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/{name}.json"
  }
}
```

Install the theme and any components:
```bash
# 1. Install theme tokens, CSS variables & typography
npx shadcn@latest add @aui/aui

# 2. Install any component directly
npx shadcn@latest add @aui/terminal
npx shadcn@latest add @aui/diff-block
npx shadcn@latest add @aui/file-tree
npx shadcn@latest add @aui/ping-status
npx shadcn@latest add @aui/property-grid
npx shadcn@latest add @aui/package-manager
npx shadcn@latest add @aui/hero
npx shadcn@latest add @aui/maxim
npx shadcn@latest add @aui/takeaways-box
npx shadcn@latest add @aui/course-card
npx shadcn@latest add @aui/stat-card
npx shadcn@latest add @aui/social-pill
```

Or add directly via URL without touching `components.json`:
```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/terminal.json
```

## AI Coding Agent Setup (Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf)

Teach your AI coding agent the Array UI aesthetic and component APIs by adding the following prompt to your `.cursorrules`, `AGENTS.md`, or system instructions:

```markdown
# Design System: Array UI (@aui)
- Registry URL: https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/{name}.json
- GitHub Repository: github:arpitbbhayani/aui (not on npm registry; install via GitHub or shadcn registry)
- Style: Editorial engineering aesthetic inspired by arpitbhayani.me.
- Colors:
  - Light mode: paper background (#f9f8f5), warm hairline borders (#dfded9), dark carbon text (#2b2a30).
  - Dark mode: obsidian background (#0a0a0c), crisp dark borders (#24242c), soft white text (#d4d4db).
  - Accents: Signature crimson (#e5000f) for primary actions; amber (#cc9900) for engineering maxims; emerald (#10b981) for online/ok.
- Typography:
  - Headings: Plus Jakarta Sans / Space Grotesk (bold, tight tracking).
  - Body: Assistant (clean, dense, 15px base size).
  - Pull quotes & Maxims: Lora italic serif.
  - Code & Telemetry: Geist Mono / system monospace.
- Rules:
  - Keep borders subtle (1px, single color).
  - Minimal elevation/shadows; use flat tinted card surfaces.
  - Prefer compact, information-dense components for developer dashboards and tools.
  - Always use `cn()` from `@/lib/utils` for className composition.
```

## Available Components:
- **Terminal** (`@aui/terminal`): Machined telemetry terminal with bash command dots and styled outputs.
  Endpoint: `https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/terminal.json`
  Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/terminal`

- **DiffBlock** (`@aui/diff-block`): Git patch viewer with line gutters, additions, and deletions.
  Endpoint: `https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/diff-block.json`
  Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/diff-block`

- **PingStatus** (`@aui/ping-status`): Live telemetry pulsing dot indicator with label.
  Endpoint: `https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/ping-status.json`
  Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/ping-status`

- **PropertyGrid** (`@aui/property-grid`): Key-value metadata inspector with one-click copy functionality.
  Endpoint: `https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/property-grid.json`
  Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/property-grid`

- **PackageManager** (`@aui/package-manager`): pnpm/npm/bun/yarn command switcher with copy button.
  Endpoint: `https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/package-manager.json`
  Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/package-manager`

- **Maxim** (`@aui/maxim`): Editorial quote callout with amber left rail and citation.
  Endpoint: `https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/maxim.json`
  Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/maxim`

- **TakeawaysBox** (`@aui/takeaways-box`): Key takeaways container with bulleted highlights.
  Endpoint: `https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/takeaways-box.json`
  Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/takeaways-box`

- **Hero** (`@aui/hero`): Editorial profile hero section with avatar, heading, and bio.
  Endpoint: `https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/hero.json`
  Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/hero`

- **FileTree** (`@aui/file-tree`): Directory explorer tree with collapsible folders and item selection.
  Endpoint: `https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/file-tree.json`
  Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/file-tree`

- **SocialPill** (`@aui/social-pill`): Clean pill button with platform icon, handle, and follower count.
  Endpoint: `https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/social-pill.json`
  Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/social-pill`

- **CourseCard** (`@aui/course-card`): Editorial course and project card with badges, tags, and CTA.
  Endpoint: `https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/course-card.json`
  Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/course-card`

- **StatCard** (`@aui/stat-card`): Large key metric display card with optional trend indicator.
  Endpoint: `https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/stat-card.json`
  Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/stat-card`

- **EmptyState** (`@aui/empty-state`): Dashed container for empty content and call-to-actions.
  Endpoint: `https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/empty-state.json`
  Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/empty-state`

- **Theme Style** (`@aui/aui`): Base CSS variables, typography, and color tokens.
  Endpoint: `https://ui.arpitbhayani.me/r/aui.json`
  Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @aui/aui`
